cohort: This study followed 102 infants for the first 6 months of life.
finding: Infants' gut microbiota changed significantly over the first 6 months of life, with delivery and feeding modes significantly affecting microbial composition and function.
mod_finding: Infants born via C-section had a decrease in abundance of Bacteroidetes over time compared to those born vaginally, who had a higher abundance of Bifidobacterium.
